LEAVE AND LICENCE AGREEMENT
This agreement is made at Mumbai between the Licensor, Sample Owner B, and the Licensee, Sample Tenant B.
1. Licence Period
The licence is for a period of eleven (11) months commencing from the date of handing over possession.
2. Licence Fee
The Licensee shall pay monthly compensation of Rs. 45,000 in advance on or before the seventh of every month.
3. Security Deposit
The Licensee shall pay an interest-free refundable deposit of Rs. 2,25,000, equivalent to five months' rent. The deposit shall be returned on the Licensee vacating the premises, subject to deductions as determined by the Licensor.
4. Outgoings
The Licensee shall pay electricity charges and society maintenance charges during the licence period.
5. Notice
Either party shall give one month's written notice to terminate this licence.
6. Visits
The Licensor may inspect the premises at any time.
7. Disputes
Any dispute shall be referred to arbitration at Mumbai.
